title: 海滩渔货铺
theme: 原创小海獭在海滩渔货铺里捕捞、采集、补货和扩建
concept: 只用移动完成近岸捕鱼、潮池原地投建解锁、实体堆叠、补货、顾客结账和升级的竖屏海滩物流经营游戏
coreLoop: 移动到近岸渔网或已解锁潮池并靠近自动取货
鱼或海带以有类型可见堆叠显示在小海獭头顶
移动到对应冰盘或海带篮自动逐件补货
海边游客选货、等货、取货并前往收银台排队
玩家在收银区完成交易并让贝壳币实体化
把贝壳币直接投入未解锁的潮池，满 12 后同一位置切换为海带采集点
购买携带容量升级，并为下一阶段的虾笼预留站点

products.unlock: invest 12 shell coins directly at the locked tide-pool source; no separate construction station

requiredSystems: normalized keyboard and pointer/touch drag movement
automatic proximity harvest and compatible-shelf delivery
customer finite state machine with out-of-stock waiting and checkout queue
physical shell-token pile collected by proximity
locked tide-pool investment unlocking kelp in place with no standalone construction station
capacity upgrade with visible player-attached full-state feedback

playerAttachedCapacityIndicator.visibleWhen: carried item count equals current player capacity
playerAttachedCapacityIndicator.transition: one-shot local pulse only when entering full state
playerAttachedCapacityIndicator.placement: above the highest carried item when clear; if a cached HUD exclusion rectangle conflicts, choose the first scene-safe attached fallback from stack-right, stack-left, or player-side-below

originalityConstraints: Do not use Monkey Mart names, code, assets, UI, map layout, tuning or unlock order
Use only the generic spatial logistics mechanic and generic seafood categories
Keep all silhouettes, palette, beach layout, progression and numbers original
Use the original Chinese 满载 badge and dynamic avoidance behavior rather than copying competitor MAX lettering or styling
testRequirements: Retain exactly all seven window.__GAME_TEST__ controls
Write focused failing tests before each production behavior change and record the expected RED failure
Assert STATIONS has no standalone construction member and the old lower-right location never invests currency
Test partial investment, save recovery, the twelfth coin unlock, event positions at kelpSource, no further charge after unlock, and harvesting kelp at the same source on a later simulation tick
Test main scene and HUD copy contain only one spatial kelp unlock node and never render or mention 海带建设区 or 右下角建设区
Test fish and kelp stock compatibility, queue order, shell-token collection, upgrade and save recovery

Satisfy the WebLiteRuntimeAdapter machine contract by keeping localStorage in generated TypeScript source and declaring CURRENT_SAVE_VERSION = 3 or an equivalent accepted literal save-v3 marker; test a real refresh round trip
Test the 满载 marker at 0/4, 3/4, 4/4, unload, 4/5 and 5/5
Test the marker does not intersect cached HUD exclusion rectangles at the upper-left fish source in 360x800, 390x844 and 430x932 viewports
Test that repeating automatic interactions never trigger a full-screen camera flash
Keep the playable beach and HUD legible inside CSS safe-area insets with no horizontal overflow
